CmdhDefEcValues.label: CmdhDefEcValues
CmdhDefEcValues.description: This Object represents default set of values for the Event Category parameter of an incoming request or response message.

Order.label: Order
Order.description: Contains an index defining the order of processing this CmdhDefEcValue Object Instance will be handled

DefEcValue.label: DefEcValue
DefEcValue.description: Represents the default Event category value to be applied when the conditions given in this Object Instance are matched

RequestOrigin.label: RequestOrigin
RequestOrigin.description: List of zero or more Local AE-IDs, App-IDs, or the strings "localAE" or "thisCSE"

RequestContext.label: RequestContext
RequestContext.description: Contains the requestContext information of this Object Instance which needs to be matched

RequestContextNotification.label: RequestContextNotification
RequestContextNotification.description: Contains true/false flag indicating whether or not notification procedures apply.

RequestCharacteristics.label: RequestCharacteristics
RequestCharacteristics.description: Represents conditions pertaining to the request itself, (e.g. the requested Response Type  ) than needs to be matched
